cards.title: bolt Angular Signals Reactive Store
cards.description: Built with lightweight, fine-grained Angular Signals. The centralized ReportStore tracks patient demographics, selected test panels, entered raw values, and clinical overrides. Derived state (abnormal counts, filled counts, calculation dependencies, and validation readiness) evaluates through memorized computed() signals at 60 FPS without wasteful component re-renders.

cards.title: storage Robust Client-Side IndexedDB Engine
cards.description: Data persistence leverages browser-native IndexedDB through an asynchronous storage abstraction. Laboratories maintain thousands of patient visits, custom diagnostic panels, customized reference intervals, doctor registries, and base64 clinic logos and signatures with zero memory degradation or local storage size limitations.

cards.title: straighten CSS Paged Media Print Precision
cards.description: The reporting view strictly conforms to W3C CSS Paged Media Module Level 3 (@page, size: A4 portrait, break-inside: avoid, and millimetric margin coordinates). Print stylesheets eliminate screen UI controls and backdrop layers, delivering vector-crisp typographic hierarchy with precise 0.25pt hair-line borders suitable for both laser and high-speed clinical printing.

cards.title: monetization_on Integer Paise Monetary Arithmetic
cards.description: Patient billing and tax calculations avoid standard JavaScript floating-point representation anomalies (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3). The billing engine internally performs all financial arithmetic strictly in integer paise (₹1 = 100 paise), guaranteeing penny-accurate GST computations, percentage discount rounds, and multi-tender cash reconciliations.

cards.title: shield Native Web Crypto SHA-256 Security & Audit Trail
cards.description: Access control relies on the browser's hardware-accelerated SubtleCrypto API. Master admin passwords are authenticated against a cryptographically secure 128-bit salt and SHA-256 digest, ensuring zero plain-text credential leaks in local storage. All deletion events generate an immutable audit log tracking patient identifiers, deleted test panels, and calculated monetary amounts for full cash accountability.
